purpose: Phase 11 production transcription backfill for Phase 10 audio-bearing videos. Identical signal chain to the certified v1 shadow configuration; the only change is that accepted results are written to production tables.

diarization.reason: No approved local diarization model is configured. Speaker identity must never be inferred from voice.

meaningful_speech.policy: A short non-speech sound (a chime, a click, a breath) can be decoded into a plausible word. A chunk is meaningful speech only when the detected language is confident, the span is long enough to carry speech, and more than a single token was produced. Failing chunks are stored truthfully, withheld from search, and raised for review; the asset keeps SPEECH_PRESENT=UNKNOWN rather than a fabricated positive.

clinical_specificity_gate.policy: A spoken clinical term is evidence of speech, not evidence that the procedure is depicted. Transcript chunks containing locked high-risk clinical terminology are stored truthfully but excluded from active search text and embedding input, and raised for human review.
